authority.reason: M2 (blueprints) is not accepted, so no audit disposition is authoritative and no cut/add is decided (Cory constraints 2 and 6). Every slot is provisional until M2 is accepted and the slot is confirmed.

rules: the card is a registered project exception or authorized future-release card
only a blueprint anti-goal names it; or it is structurally independent, has no Oracle hook, no blueprint mention, weak EDHREC support and a named alternative (a review candidate, not a cut)
structurally important: breaks a Spellbook combo, a blueprint tutor target, or a win piece / enabler
its job is a non-required blueprint package (keeps its value only while that package stays)
narrow hate / taxing text whose value depends on what opponents play
a plain role card or basic land with many role / colour mates (FLEX_RED or more) and no structure
fills a key role, the mana base, or a required package, with fewer mates
none of the above, but an Oracle hook, blueprint mention or EDHREC support

baseline_sim.keep_rule: keep 2-5 lands with (lands + mana sources costing <= 2) >= 3; otherwise mulligan; always keep at 5 cards or fewer; bottom (London): excess lands beyond 4 first, then the highest mana value nonlands
